proposedOverrides.summary: The Merina kingdom grew from Madagascar’s central highlands. Andrianampoinimerina consolidated power in the late eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries through war, trade and family connections. The map’s early starting date does not establish that this kingdom existed in the year 1000.

sharedAssociations.basis: The adjacent imported Merina and Imerina labels cover overlapping highland territory. A shared card distinguishes the kingdom’s expansion and1897ending from the imported1000–1914coverage.
